title: Molecular orbitals of nitrogen
caption: For N₂ (and lighter diatomics) the π2p orbitals lie below σ2p. Its ten valence electrons fill up to σ2p with none in antibonding 2p orbitals: bond order 3, all electrons paired. This triple bond (945 kJ mol⁻¹) makes N₂ very unreactive.
alt: MO diagram of N₂: σ2s and σ*2s full, π2p (two) and σ2p full, π*2p and σ*2p empty.
description: π2p: both full; σ2p: full (here above π2p).
π*2p and σ*2p: empty. Bond order 3, diamagnetic.
